## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit + e2e where user-facing)
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard, focus, axe, reduced motion)
- [ ] Performance impact considered (bundle budget, LCP, CLS)
- [ ] Content model / persisted query change? Shared schema + `ue/` updated, AEM team notified
- [ ] ADR added/updated for architectural decisions
- [ ] Follow-ups listed below (review feedback must be actionable)
